item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 09/Apr/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry continental airstream will persistently affect southern China today and tomorrow. The weather will be generally fine over the region. It will be hot during the day. Winds will be weak and the visibility will be relatively low over the coast of Guangdong early next week. The northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coastal areas midweek next week, it will be cloudier with a few showers over the region. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Malakas over the western North Pacific is expected to move across the seas east of the Philippines in the next few days and intensify gradually. It will then subsequently move in the general direction of the seas south of Japan.
